title: Global ignition is unique to conscious states

statements.text: Global ignition occurs only for conscious contents: nonconscious stimuli do not reproducibly evoke intense prefrontal activation, P3b waves, or late distributed brain-scale synchronization.
statements.falsification_criteria: Nonconscious stimuli found to reproducibly evoke intense PFC activations, P3b waves, or late and distributed patterns of brain-scale synchronization.

sources.locator: Can Nonconscious Stimuli Produce a Global Ignition?
sources.quote: Another pillar of the proposed theoretical synthesis is that global ignition is unique to conscious states.
